upload.heading: Drag & Drop Files Here
tips.title: iPhone Upload Tips & Optimization
tips.slowTitle: Why selecting many photos from Photos can be slow
tips.slowCompressed: Compressed access: Apple may provide temporary processed versions of photos and videos from Photos.
tips.slowProcessing: Slow processing: Large batches can require conversion, compression, and export before upload.
tips.slowCrash: Crash risk: Heavy processing can freeze the picker or browser on older devices.
tips.filesTitle: Benefits of using the Files app
tips.filesIntro: When you pick files from the Files app, the browser can usually read already-exported files directly.
tips.filesTypes: Support for ZIP, RAR, PDF, and other file types.
tips.browserChrome: Small batches: Chrome can select multiple Photos items; keep batches around 20-30 files for best results.
tips.browserSafari: Safari limitation: Safari may restrict Photos selection to one photo or video at a time.
modal.noFilesBody: Select files before starting an upload.
modal.noFilesPhone: Use Choose Files on a phone or tablet.
modal.noFilesDesktop: Drag files into the upload area on a desktop.
modal.alreadyBody: All files in this list have already been processed.
modal.securityDefault: Open this page from Local Media Transfer on Windows using its current one-time browser link.
modal.securityNote: Uploads stay locked until this page is opened with a valid link.
modal.noToken: This page was opened without a valid one-time access link. In Local Media Transfer on Windows, select Open in Browser or copy the current one-time browser link. You can also scan the current connection QR code.
modal.invalidToken: This one-time link is invalid, expired, or has already been used. Create a new link in Local Media Transfer on Windows and open it again.
security.disabledTitle: Locked: a valid access link is required
security.lockedBanner: Uploads are locked. Open this page with the current one-time link from Local Media Transfer on Windows, or scan the current connection QR code.
